svg.text: FDAA-assisted chiral derivatization and TIMS-MS discrimination of alanine enantiomers
Diastereomers: same neutral formula C₁₂H₁₅N₅O₇ and molecular mass
Schematic illustration; peak order unassigned. TIMS measures derivative ions, potentially metal-adduct ions.
Xie et al., Chem. Sci. 2022 • DOI: 10.1039/D2SC03604E; Marfey 1984 • DOI: 10.1007/BF02908688
